note: Names are declarations for Ubuntu Server 22.04, 24.04, and 26.04. No package in this catalog is vm-passed.

google-chrome.note: Project browser only. Installer never installs it. The helper reads latest_stable from the pinned GitHub mirror at install time and checks that zip SHA-256. Rendering verification requires VM certification.

mongodb.note: Vendor repository and architecture are untested on every supported Ubuntu.

php-fpm.note: PHP is installed as a pinned side-by-side runtime, not by changing the system default.

nodejs.note: Node.js is a project runtime. The system Node package is not assumed.

python.note: Project Python uses a venv. /usr/bin/python3 is not modified.

docker.note: Optional software. Not a dependency of the panel or of project deployment.
